probability_pooling.per_order: softmax over all four candidate mean log scores
probability_pooling.consensus: arithmetic mean of canonical-order and reversed-order probability vectors

aggregation.denominator: total selected assignment weight across all roles and all four probability classes
aggregation.innovation: current joint mass minus a prior-only finite 63-session EWMA with half-life 21 sessions

controls.stale20: lag only the 18 current/innovation semantic fields by 20 stock sessions; keep current no-news and score-quality fields
controls.wrong_stock: replace target-specific I/P current and innovation fields with the fixed alphabetically next stock in the same sector and date; retain recipient C, no-news, and score-quality fields
controls.permuted: within forecast-date and sector, deterministically permute each unique article's complete four-class consensus vector as one unit; retain recipient assignment weights, roles, and original order-JSD quality; then reaggregate and recompute innovations and coupling
controls.transformed_mass_decomposition_audit: not applicable and null for stale20 and wrong_stock because their semantic fields no longer share the current p_other denominator; valid and recomputed for canonical and permuted
